title.rendered: Back to School Night, Thursday, 9/26/24 @ 5:30 pm

content.rendered:
Our Archer Glen Back to School Night will be held on Thursday, September 26th from 5:30 – 7:00 pm. This year, we will be doing an open house event and students are welcome to attend with their parents! There will be no set session times, instead families can attend during the open house timeframe that works best for them. Families will get to visit classrooms and pick up a Scavenger Hunt to participate in some of the curriculum activities students have been engaged in, visit our PE/Music/STEM classes, explore the Archer Glen campus, and get information about our parent volunteer group, PAC! Students can submit their completed Scavenger Hunt forms for a drawing to earn $10 to spend at our upcoming Book Fair.

With so many families visiting classrooms during our Back to School Night, this will not be a time for teachers to talk to each family about student progress. Time will be provided for these conversations during conferences at the end of October. Please save the date and plan to join us for a wonderful evening where your students get to show off what they have been learning so far this year!
